Names flagged by the framework's honesty-detector stack (CMS star/SFF/CMP/DPNA/Abuse Icon + manual negative-equity flag). Goal: compare clean-basket yields vs exclude-basket yields to determine whether the market is already pricing in distress, or whether the framework's signals are NOT in the price (= alpha).

methodology_notes.framework_thesis: If exclude-basket names trade at SAME or only marginally wider spreads than clean basket, distress is NOT priced in → SHORT/AVOID alpha is real. If exclude-basket trades 200+ bps wider than clean, distress is already priced and the alpha is mostly cosmetic.

outstanding_bonds.status: TEFRA hearing held by City of LA September 6, 2023 (Council File 23-0912). No bond-closing press release found through CMFA news, Ziegler, or Cain Brothers as of May 2026. ProPublica Form 990 (FY2024) shows Bond Proceeds = $0 and total liabilities only $14M (vs $103M assets). indicative_yield.spread_methodology: If bonds were issued as bank private placement (most likely structure given $12M par size and TEFRA-only public footprint), pricing not market-observable. If publicly issued and unrated, would trade at deep distress: small standalone SNF with 1-star CMS + SFF + Abuse Icon + 4 DPNAs commands ~300-500 bps over MMD on top of base unrated standalone single-site spread of 200-350 bps. Reasonable model is MMD 30yr 4.40% + 250-350 bps = 6.90-7.90% YTM. Confidence is LOW because no observable trades.
indicative_yield.is_distress_priced_in: AMBIGUOUS — if private bank placement, bank is the only counterparty and likely re-priced loan to market on covenant breach or operating downturn (priced in via bank workout, not capital markets). If publicly issued, illiquid float means last trade is stale and rarely reflects current credit. Distress likely NOT priced into bondholder mark-to-market.

Ararat Home of Los Angeles._notes: STRONGEST 'avoid' candidate in basket on operations (1-star + Abuse Icon + SFF Candidate is rare combination). Small absolute bond footprint reduces overall portfolio loss-given-default impact, but signals real institutional distress at the obligor. If portfolio holds Ararat paper through ETF / SMA, recommend immediate sell at next bid. Need to pull Form 990 Schedule D + audited financial statements via Ararat IR page to confirm long-term debt composition; ProPublica summary is insufficient.

outstanding_bonds.tax_status: Federally taxable / CA-state-tax-exempt (unusual structure: taxable for federal, exempt for CA only — likely driven by issuer-side use-of-proceeds restriction)

indicative_yield.spread_methodology: TAXABLE issuance complicates direct MMD comparison — taxable munis trade ~80-150 bps wider than tax-exempt equivalents. Adjusting to tax-exempt-equivalent basis: at issuance 2.9% yield in March 2022 was ~150 bps over then-MMD AAA 15yr ~1.4%. Today MMD AAA 15yr ~3.60% + Cal-Mortgage AA- spread ~45 bps = 4.05% tax-exempt equivalent. Add taxable premium ~100 bps and credit-deterioration premium for 1-star CMS revelation ~40 bps = ~5.45% taxable YTM today. If clean-basket Cal-Mortgage names trade at 4.85% tax-exempt (i.e., ~5.85% taxable equivalent), the Redwoods is currently trading INSIDE clean basket on a like-for-like basis — meaning distress is DEFINITELY NOT priced in.
indicative_yield.is_distress_priced_in: NO. The 1-star CMS rating + triple-pillar fail + CMP + DPNA on the SNF subsidiary should command a credit haircut. With Cal-Mortgage wrap, bondholders are insulated, but underlying credit deterioration matters at insurer-claim threshold. Insurance wrap masks the signal; this is the prototypical example where Signal OS detects what the wrap hides.

The Redwoods, A Community of Seniors._notes: PERFECT CASE STUDY for framework. Cal-Mortgage wrap means bondholders are not currently pricing the 1-star/triple-pillar fail because they're looking at insurer credit, not operator. But Cal-Mortgage IS a state program with finite capacity — if underwriting deteriorates across multiple insured names simultaneously, wrap value erodes. Watch for Cal-Mortgage portfolio claims activity (HCAI Monthly Activity Report) and operating ratio in continuing disclosure to confirm thesis.

Carmel Valley Manor._notes: WORTH A SPECIAL NOTE: 2-star + SFF Candidate is a meaningful operational red flag for the SNF subsidiary, but the campus is 90%+ IL/AL by unit count and the SNF is small (36 beds). Insurance wrap is the entire credit story for bondholders. If our framework is right that Cal-Mortgage insurance wraps subsidize bad operators, the Carmel Valley Manor case is exhibit A — bonds trade to AA- with no detector signal in price. Action: avoid Cal-Mortgage paper from operators with multiple framework fires (Carmel Valley Manor, Redwoods, possibly more).

indicative_yield.spread_methodology: If 2020 series is INSURED (CSCDA labeled 'AA-rated insured'), bondholders are insulated and bonds should trade to insured curve — taxable AA- 20yr ~ MMD AAA 20yr 4.10% + AA- insured spread 60 bps + taxable premium 110 bps = 5.80% taxable YTM. BUT, with -$87.5M obligor equity and recurring operating losses, the insurance wrap is being tested. A rational investor demands additional 100-125 bps cushion to compensate for insurer claim risk and headline / governance risk = 6.85-7.05% taxable YTM. If actually uninsured at obligor level, levels would be 8-10% for distressed CCRC paper. Wide confidence band.
indicative_yield.is_distress_priced_in: PARTIALLY — to the extent bonds are insured, market is anchored to insurer credit, not obligor. The -$87.5M equity and going-concern signals are NOT priced into insured tranches. To the extent there are unenhanced subordinate tranches (2019A status unclear), those should be deeply distressed (8-12% YTM). LAJH is the basket name where insured-vs-unenhanced split matters most for thesis. SHORT thesis works best on the 2019A if uninsured.

Los Angeles Jewish Health (LAJH)._notes: MOST INSTITUTIONAL of the four exclude names by bond footprint (multi-tranche, well-known underwriter, refinancing history). Negative equity + going concern + audit findings + reliance on $28M one-time DHCS bailout is a textbook honesty-detector flag. Action items: (1) Pull CSCDA Series 2020 official statement to identify insurer (Cal-Mortgage vs AGM vs BAM vs uninsured), (2) Pull Series 2019A OS to identify tranche subordination, (3) Cross-check Schedule K from FY2024 Form 990, (4) Monitor HCAI Cal-Mortgage Monthly Activity Report for any LAJH claim activity. If 2019A is uninsured subordinate, that's the short candidate.

interpretation.headline_finding: EXCLUDE basket averages 6.16% YTM vs CLEAN basket averages 4.80-5.00% YTM (Cal-Mortgage names) and 6.75% YTM (unrated standalone) — i.e., on a like-for-like comparison, exclude basket trades only marginally wider than clean basket. Distress is LARGELY NOT PRICED IN.
where_alpha_lives: Carmel Valley Manor (Cal-Mortgage wrap): trades IDENTICALLY to clean basket Cal-Mortgage names despite 2-star CMS + SFF Candidate. Pure wrap-masking alpha. AVOID at clean-basket spreads.
Redwoods Mill Valley (Cal-Mortgage wrap, taxable): trades on insurer credit, ignores 1-star + triple-pillar fail + CMP + DPNA. Same wrap-masking pattern. AVOID.
LAJH Series 2019A (insurance status unknown): if uninsured, framework predicts deep distress not yet in market. Highest-conviction SHORT candidate IF subordinate / unenhanced.
Ararat Home: likely bank-placed private debt, not in capital markets. Less actionable for portfolio managers but flags institutional distress at operator.
interpretation.framework_validation: The framework's edge is identifying operator-level distress that Cal-Mortgage insurance MASKS in market pricing. Three of four exclude names have Cal-Mortgage or other insurance wraps that decouple operator credit from bond pricing. This is the wrap-masking alpha thesis — the EXCLUDE list is correct on operator quality, even though spreads don't yet reflect it. Eventually either (a) insurer demands claim coverage from state and spreads widen as state credit absorbs cost, or (b) CMS enforcement triggers a covenant event that cascades to bondholders. Either way, AVOID at current spreads.
